title: Remove or harden MCP_DEV_TOKEN backdoor
acceptance: Static dev token cannot bypass OAuth in production; if kept, requires 32+ byte random secret, maps to a real userId (not global projectRoot), and logs a startup warning when set.
notes: Verified live: MCP_DEV_TOKEN key present in .env.docker. Backdoor maps to global projectRoot with no userId -> breaks multi-tenant isolation.

title: Gate OAuth /register behind admin approval
acceptance: Anonymous POST /register no longer auto-creates a usable OAuth client; registration requires admin auth or a signed client assertion. Phishing-consent path closed.
notes: Open registration + auto-adoption in authorize flow = confused-deputy / phishing vector.

title: Add SEO generation layer (sitemap, robots, JSON-LD, OG)
acceptance: GET /sitemap.xml and GET /robots.txt served from live blog posts + published projects; blog posts and homepage emit <script type=application/ld+json> (BlogPosting/Article) and og:/twitter: meta; verified crawlable in view-source.
notes: User-stated TOP priority. Current seo-meta-audit.ts is audit-only, generates nothing. SSR foundation already crawlable, only generation layer missing.

title: Stop get_blog_post leaking draft content
acceptance: get_blog_post returns draft content only to admin/author; non-privileged callers get 404 for non-published slugs.
notes: Verified: handler calls getBlogPostBySlug with no status gate, returns full JSON regardless of draft/published.

title: Fix docker bind-mount footgun (whole repo into container)
acceptance: Container can no longer write host source/.env/compose; app source mounted read-only and user workspace is a separate dedicated volume.
notes: ./:/data/workspace lets a compromised container modify host repo = supply-chain risk.

title: Add keyed-lock to JSON state writes
acceptance: setHomepage/setToolEnabled/setSkillEnabled/oauth persist use withKeyedLock; concurrent writes no longer lose updates (covered by a race test).
notes: blog/project already locked; these four state files are unlocked read-modify-write -> lost updates under concurrency.

title: Add rate limiting to /mcp endpoint
acceptance: Per-client/per-user token-bucket limit on /mcp (e.g. default 100 req/min) returns 429 when exceeded; configurable via env.
notes: Login is rate-limited (5/15min) but MCP tool calls are not -> DOS / resource exhaustion.

title: Homepage rollback + serve-time fallback
acceptance: site-state keeps previous-homepage history; if the live homepage project becomes unpublished/deleted, serve auto-falls back instead of hard 503; clear_homepage/rollback available.
notes: Currently single homepage state, no undo; deleted project = permanent 503.

title: Backup/restore + postgres schema migration tooling
acceptance: Documented + scripted pg_dump backup and .docker-data snapshot; versioned migrations replacing ad-hoc create-if-not-exists; pool.end() on shutdown.
notes: No backup automation, no real migration versioning, pg pool not closed on shutdown.
